messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Errors message when used runMI to impute my missing data for SEM
parts:
> imput <- runMI(data = data3, model = modelSE.b, m = 10,
+                fun = "cfa", seed = 12345, miPackage = "Amelia")
Ошибка: Subscript `AMr1.orig` is a matrix, the data `x.imp[AMr1.orig]` must have size 1.

I don't recognize that.  I am guessing it is the imputation software.  I recommend (always) imputing your data first, then passing the list of imputations to runMI().  Certainly you are going to fit more than 1 model to your imputations anyway, and focusing on imputing data using that software will allow you more control over those features (as well as figuring out where errors come from).

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
